en: The image shows a waterfront scene with a classic steamboat named 'Gustafsberg IV' docked in the foreground. Several people, some wearing hats, are boarding or standing near the boat. The Swedish flag is visible on the left side of the boat. Across the water is a large, ornate neoclassical building, and other historic European-style buildings can be seen further in the background. The setting appears to be urban, with clear skies and a calm river.
